definitions.explanation: Physically cool or chilly to the touch or in temperature.
Showing a cold, detached, or unsympathetic attitude toward someone or something.

examples.japanese: {冷|ひ}ややかな{風|かぜ}が{吹|ふ}いた。
{井戸|いど}から{汲|く}んだ{水|みず}は{冷|ひ}ややかだった。
examples.english: The water drawn from the well was cool.

examples.japanese: {秋|あき}の{朝|あさ}の{冷|ひ}ややかな{空気|くうき}が{気持|きも}ちよかった。
examples.english: The crisp, cool air of the autumn morning felt pleasant.

examples.japanese: {冷|ひ}ややかな{目|め}で{見|み}られた。
examples.english: I was looked at with cold eyes.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}の{態度|たいど}は{終始|しゅうし}{冷|ひ}ややかだった。
{周囲|しゅうい}の{冷|ひ}ややかな{反応|はんのう}にもかかわらず、{彼|かれ}は{提案|ていあん}を{続|つづ}けた。
examples.english: Despite the cold reception from those around him, he continued with his proposal.

notes:
A na-adjective that describes both physical coolness and emotional coldness.

FORMS:
・{冷|ひ}ややかな + noun (modifier)
・{冷|ひ}ややかに + verb (adverbial)
・{冷|ひ}ややかだ (predicate)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{冷|ひ}ややかな{目|め} (cold eyes, cold gaze)
・{冷|ひ}ややかな{態度|たいど} (cold attitude)
・{冷|ひ}ややかな{反応|はんのう} (cold response)
・{冷|ひ}ややかな{視線|しせん} (frosty stare)
・{冷|ひ}ややかに{見|み}る (to look on coldly)

DISTINCTIONS:
・{冷|ひ}ややか: cool with a sense of detachment; often describes attitude or gaze
・{冷|つめ}たい: straightforwardly cold (temperature or personality); more direct and common
・{冷|ひ}やっこい: colloquial for physically cold to the touch
